purpose: User-requested exact vehicle models. This is a requirements register, not the active vehicle catalogue or proof that assets exist.
variantPolicy: Slash-separated variants are preserved verbatim within the original request line. One line is not necessarily one individual variant.
scopeNotes: Adds to all earlier requested vehicles; does not replace them.
Audi and BMW group labels are inferred from the model families in the message; the message had no explicit BMW heading.
The source message joins Mercedes VLE / Classe V and BMW Série 1 on the same line; separated here without losing either.
The final XM line lacks its closing parenthesis in the source and is preserved as received.
Cage Wrangler and all commercial model identities/specifications remain unverified. No names are silently corrected.
The generic airliner asset already integrated is not proof of any specific model in this list.
acceptanceCriteriaPerModel: fuel or energy appropriate to the vehicle
real native build and gameplay evidence
